annotations.title: Unlink a segment from a campaign

description: Stop taking leads from a segment. Its leads that were never written to, that you didn't add by hand, and that no other linked segment still matches, leave the campaign (`withdrawn`). A lead already emailed stays, and so does one a person added (`contacted` counts the first kind). The contacts themselves stay. Unlinking a segment that isn't linked answers 404. A segment can be deleted once nothing links it.

idempotencyKey.description: Your own id for this one call, such as a UUID, up to 255 characters. If the call fails with no answer, call again with the same key and the same arguments: within 24 hours, a saved answer comes back instead of a second run. A call left unanswered can run again after 15 minutes, so a send also keeps its intentKey or draft revision.

segmentId.description: The linked segment to take off.
